question: Under what placement conditions is moving a Śiva liṅga prohibited?
premises: A Śiva liṅga may be well-situated or ill-situated.
Movement of the liṅga is being regulated.
The injunction explicitly negates moving it.
inference: Therefore, a Śiva liṅga must not be moved, whether it is well-situated or ill-situated.
plain_english: Whether well-situated or even ill-situated, one should not move a Śiva liṅga.
